issues.description: Q4: ② 'producing' vs 'produced'. 'Mailed-out coupons...producing just as much customer response' — 'producing' makes 'coupons' seem like they are actively producing (which is semantically valid as a participial phrase modifying 'coupons'). However, in context, 'produced' is the main verb of the sentence. 'producing' creates a dangling participle issue since the sentence structure requires a main finite verb. The error is clear but a sophisticated student may argue participial reading is possible. Risk: low.

Q20 wa='the time and mental energy required to think' (8단어). 조건: [and / energy / mental / required / the / think / time / to] = 8 tokens. wa를 구성하면 'the time and mental energy required to think' = the(1) time(2) and(3) mental(4) energy(5) required(6) to(7) think(8) = 8단어. 조건의 모든 단어가 wa에 포함됨. 검증 통과.
